note: Ordered: first match wins, exceptions at the top. Title rules match a whole title line of the principal attachment; subject rules are weaker fallbacks used when the text layer is missing or silent. No match -> RECUPERARE. v2.2: DT-030..DT-032 are the title-exclusive reader ported from arm B (basis 'title_exclusive'); their result is never final by itself: it is put next to the agreement reader (title_families) and the pair is looked up in 'title_merge'. 'defs' holds patterns written once and used as {NAME} inside the rules; a list entry '@key' stands for the word list stored under that key.
defs_note: INVERTING: word stems that, on a title line, turn the act named there into an act ABOUT it (an opposition, a reply, a withdrawal, a suspension request, a draft...). A stem matches from the start of a word (OPPOS -> OPPOSIZIONE, OPPOSTO); NON is a whole word (NONCHE' is not a negation). CONTESTAZ, not CONTEST: 'DIFFIDA E CONTESTUALE MESSA IN MORA' is a plain demand. PAGAT, SALDAT, ADEMPIUT, AVVENUT, EFFETTUAT: the title says the thing demanded has been done ('ATTO DI PRECETTO - PAGAMENTO EFFETTUATO'); PAGAMENTO and SALDO do not match them. The list is a net, not a taxonomy: a word it lacks is caught by the head position or not at all. OTHER_ACT_SYNONYMS: names of other acts that arm A's families know and arm B's exclusivity lists did not. ABOUT_TAIL and NOT_A_DEMAND_TAIL are looked for only on the title line of the act, AFTER its name (the pattern that uses them is bound to the line with [^\n]*): ABOUT_TAIL = the line goes on describing the act as a thing already received or sent, or asks something about it ('ATTO DI PRECETTO PERVENUTO', 'LETTERA DI DIFFIDA GIA' INVIATA - RICHIESTA DI CHIARIMENTI'); NOT_A_DEMAND_TAIL = the line makes the diffida another act ('MESSA IN MORA DEL CREDITORE' is mora credendi, art. 1206 c.c.; 'DIFFIDA ACCERTATIVA' is an act of the labour inspectorate; 'DIFFIDA DAL PROSEGUIRE' forbids instead of demanding; DISDETTA, RECESSO, RISOLUZIONE name a second act) - all [TO CONFIRM with counsel]. A letterhead line such as 'DIREZIONE AMMINISTRATIVA' is another line and does not count. The tail of a precetto or a diffida stays OPEN apart from these lists (only the reminder has a closed tail): a tail outside the lists that changes the act is not caught.
title_words_note: Word lists of the title-exclusive rules. title_before_words = title_neutral_words (the agreement reader's frame, one list for both readers) + title_head_extra_words (+ title_ordinal_words for a reminder and a demand: 'SECONDO SOLLECITO', 'ULTIMA DIFFIDA'): only these may stand before the act name on its title line. They are containers (ATTO, LETTERA, RACCOMANDATA), register words (FORMALE, STRAGIUDIZIALE, URGENTE), function words, INVITO ('INVITO E DIFFIDA' is one demand said twice, not two acts) and RINNOVAZIONE (a renewed precetto is a precetto); a noun that names another speech act (RICHIESTA, INTIMAZIONE, RISCONTRO, PROPOSTA...) is a head in its own right and stays out. title_sollecito_tail_words: the only words that may follow SOLLECITO - what is reminded must be a payment ('SOLLECITO RATE ARRETRATE', 'ULTIMO AVVISO PRIMA DELLE VIE LEGALI'), never a document, a reply or a delivery.

title_families_note: v2.1 second path, used only when NO strict title/text rule above matched and the text is readable. Reading 1: an upper-case title line of the heading names one or more act families ('title') inside a NEUTRAL FRAME - apart from the family names, the line may contain only 'title_neutral_words' and reference numbers; any other word (OPPOSIZIONE A, REVOCA DELLA, PREAVVISO DI, RISCONTRO A...) may turn the act into a different one, so the title is not understood -> RECUPERARE. Reading 2, independent: the PEC subject names the same family ('subject'), or the text states a relative term that equals the term of that act in rules/terms.json (same start event; same number of days where the act has a statutory one). The type is committed only when exactly ONE family is confirmed; a family that nothing confirms, or two confirmed families, is RECUPERARE - and it also vetoes the weaker subject-only fallback (DT-050..), which stays for documents without a text layer.

title_merge_note: v2.2 merge of the two title readers, used only when no strict title/text rule (DT-001..DT-024) matched and the text is readable. 'exclusive' is what the title-exclusive rules DT-030.. say (committed | silent); 'agreement' is what the agreement reader (title_families) says: silent (no family on a title line), not_understood (a family among foreign words), unconfirmed (a family in a neutral frame, no independent confirmation), committed (exactly one confirmed family), conflict (two or more confirmed families); same_type compares the two committed types. Ordered, first match wins, abstentions at the top. Outcomes: RECUPERARE | exclusive (the rule's type) | agreement (the agreement reader's type) | fallback (the ordered rules' own result). A pair of readings that no row describes is RECUPERARE.

title_merge.rationale: the two title readers commit DIFFERENT types: the title-exclusive rule reads one act, the agreement reader has another family confirmed by an independent reading (subject or stated term). Neither is preferred: a disagreement is an abstention
